audit_metadata.title: Sprint 6.0.1 Backtest Accounting Reconciliation & Benchmark Audit

brokerage.cause: Sprint 6.0 report table estimated 621 * 20.0 (one leg only), whereas engine executed two legs (buy and sell brokerage of ₹20 each per trade).

stt.cause: Report approximated turnover using invested capital (₹5.72 Cr) rather than actual raw turnover (₹5.70 Cr buy, ₹5.71 Cr sell). Reported share 65.42% was an unnormalized prototype relic.

stamp_duty.cause: Report approximated using invested capital rather than raw buy turnover base.

gst.cause: Report calculated GST on one-leg brokerage only, whereas engine levied 18% GST on both buy and sell legs.

slippage.cause: Exact match (within 1 paisa floating point rounding).

total_friction.finding: The simulation engine and Trade Ledger accurately deducted ₹213,207.51 total costs across all 621 trades with 100% mathematical precision. The discrepancies existed solely in the Markdown report formatting interpolation of Section 3.

pnl_and_equity_reconciliation.variance_explanation: On session 388 close, 8 positions remained open in the portfolio ledger valued at mark-to-market without hypothetical sell friction. The trade ledger closed them synthetically for trade-level statistics, deducting ₹1,198.28 in hypothetical sell costs. Reconciles to 10 paise.

turnover_reconciliation.classification: Reported turnover of ₹5.72 Crore is One-Way Buy-Side Invested Capital (including buy fees), equivalent to ~₹5.71 Crore average one-way turnover or ₹11.41 Crore combined two-way turnover.

buy_and_hold_benchmark.name: NIFTY 50 Equal-Weight Buy & Hold
buy_and_hold_benchmark.friction_modeled: Gross (no execution costs or slippage subtracted)

non_ml_baseline.name: Non-ML Top-10 Static Baseline
non_ml_baseline.nature: Static buy-and-hold (zero trades, zero rotation, zero friction)
non_ml_baseline.fairness_finding: Not a rotating swing trading baseline. Benefits from holding 10 large-cap winners with 100% continuous market exposure and zero delivery friction.
